translation_en: …there is a sudden awakening, and the Way is then within oneself. Proceeding from this to making the intentions sincere, rectifying the mind, and cultivating the person, and extending it to governing the state and bringing peace to the world—this is what it means to be a scholar who possesses the Way. If the examination system truly obtains such men and employs them, then the governance of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties may nearly be attained. As for the superficial habits of literary composition, or the trivialities of the technical arts of law and mathematics—even supposing one masters them to perfection, if one's learning is not rooted in body and mind, then the man is after all just an ordinary person. What use would those who are good at planning for governance have for him? Alas! Since the teachings of Zou and Lu died out, the Way of the world declined ever further; through the Han, Jin, Sui, and Tang dynasties, scholars had long been deaf and blind to this Way. Fortunately, in the Song dynasty there were several noble men—Zhou Dunyi, the Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, and Zhu Xi—who rose up a hundred generations later, illuminating the surviving Classics in order to enlighten scholars. Yet the rulers of that time instead…

title: 成化十年順天府鄉試錄
text:
以偽學目之擯斥弗用宋之
治所以止於宋而不能唐虞
三代有以哉我
太祖高皇帝甫定武功即興文教
科目雖斟酌近代之制而試
士之法則一本之周程張朱
經術之學創制之初固已度
===
越前代矣而
列聖相承所以陶鎔天下之人物
收拾天下之才智以為興道
致治之具者
重光協德先後一軌是以百餘
年間大道之要明于上至治
之澤洽于下斯世斯民何其
punctuated: 以偽學目之，擯斥弗用。宋之治所以止於宋，而不能唐、虞、三代，有以哉！我太祖高皇帝甫定武功，即興文教。科目雖斟酌近代之制，而試士之法，則一本之周、程、張、朱經術之學。創制之初，固已度越前代矣。而列聖相承，所以陶鎔天下之人物，收拾天下之才智，以為興道致治之具者，重光協德，先後一軌。是以百餘年間，大道之要明于上，至治之澤洽于下，斯世斯民，何其
translation_en: …regarded it as "spurious learning," rejecting and refusing to employ them. That the governance of the Song remained merely that of the Song, unable to attain the level of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties—there was indeed a reason for this! When our Grand Progenitor, Emperor Gao (Taizu, the Hongwu Emperor), had barely settled his military achievements, he immediately promoted civil education. Although the examination system was adapted with consideration of the institutions of recent dynasties, the method of testing scholars was rooted entirely in the classical learning of Zhou Dunyi, the Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, and Zhu Xi. From the very beginning of establishing these institutions, it already far surpassed previous dynasties. Moreover, as the successive sacred emperors inherited the throne, the means by which they molded the men of the empire and gathered the talents and wisdom of the world to serve as instruments for advancing the Way and achieving good governance were marked by cumulative splendor and harmonious virtue, following the exact same track from first to last. Therefore, for over a hundred years, the essentials of the Great Way have shone clearly above, and the blessings of supreme governance have permeated below. This age and this people—how…

title: 成化十年順天府鄉試錄
text:
幸歟況畿甸之士當
輦轂之下言行政事之善可師
可法者得之尤先則今日之
與選者文章議論固宜其皆
本于經深于道可以式萬方
而表四國也於乎盛哉雖然
此猶誦說之知耳行將捷春
===
官對
大廷以有官序其益思所以力
行斯道以周程張朱之學術
自勵以唐虞三代之事業自
期不底于大就不已焉此固
國家科目取士之初意而亦區
區今日與考校者之切望也
punctuated: 幸歟！況畿甸之士，當輦轂之下，言行政事之善可師可法者，得之尤先。則今日之與選者，文章議論固宜其皆本于經、深于道，可以式萬方而表四國也。於乎，盛哉！雖然，此猶誦說之知耳。行將捷春官，對大廷，以有官序，其益思所以力行斯道，以周、程、張、朱之學術自勵，以唐、虞、三代之事業自期，不底于大就不已焉。此固國家科目取士之初意，而亦區區今日與考校者之切望也。
translation_en: …fortunate! Moreover, the scholars of the capital region, residing beneath the imperial chariot, are the very first to gain access to excellence in words, deeds, and governance that is worthy of emulation and modeling. Thus, for those selected today, their literary compositions and discourses ought indeed to be wholly rooted in the Classics and profound in the Way, so that they may serve as a standard for the myriad regions and an exemplar for the four quarters of the realm. Oh, how magnificent! Even so, this is still merely the knowledge of recitation and exposition. Soon they will triumph at the Ministry of Rites, reply in the great court, and take up official rank. May they think ever more deeply on how to strenuously practice this Way, encouraging themselves with the learning of Zhou Dunyi, the Cheng brothers, Zhang Zai, and Zhu Xi, and setting their sights on the achievements of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties, never stopping until they reach great accomplishment. This is assuredly the original intent of the dynasty in selecting scholars through the examination categories, and it is also my own earnest hope as one who participated in the examining today.

title: 成化十年順天府鄉試錄
text:
鄉試錄成僭書此于後與諸
士子共勉之
翰林院修撰儒林郎劉健謹
序
punctuated:
鄉試錄成，僭書此于後，與諸士子共勉之。
翰林院修撰、儒林郎劉健謹序。
translation_en:
Now that the Record of the Provincial Examination is complete, I have presumed to write these words at the end, so that the scholars and I may encourage one another in this endeavor.
Respectfully written in postface by Liu Jian 劉健, Senior Compiler of the Hanlin Academy and Gentleman for Confucian Service.
